{{Quote|You showed them the Altar?|Father|<ref name="Altar of Mortis (episode)">{{TCW|Altar of Mortis (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Altar of Mortis''' was a structure that was located in a cavern deep underground on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]]. It safeguarded the [[Dagger of Mortis/Legends|Dagger of Mortis]], a weapon that was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] such powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielders]] such as the [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]] and [[Son/Legends|his]] [[Daughter/Legends|children]]. It was the Daughter who brought [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] here to find the means of killing the Son. The futile attempt to kill the Son resulted in the death of the Daughter when the dagger fell into the hands of the Son bringing unbalance to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
